newsitem.title: USA: Crown Pacific CEO ups investment in company.
newsitem.headline: Crown Pacific CEO ups investment in company.

text.p: Crown Pacific Partners LP said its President and Chief Executive Officer Peter Stott bought 10,000 of the company's common Units.
This was in addition to the 15,000 units Stott bought in February, the company said.

Stott also told the company he might buy another 25,000 units from time to time in the open market, subject to market conditions. Stott owned 1.5 million general, subordinated and limited partnership unit equivalents representing 5.6 percent of Crown Pacific Partners LP, it said.
